newsitem.title: CHINA: China province to spend 160 bln yuan on upgrades.
newsitem.headline: China province to spend 160 bln yuan on upgrades.

text.p: China's northeastern province of Liaoning will invest 160 billion yuan ($19.28 billion) to upgrade industrial technology and machinery over the next five years, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.

The provincial government will give priority to renovations at 200 key state operations and 30 major petrochemical, metallurgical, machinery and electronic information companies, it said without giving further details.
During the last five years, the province had invested a total of 83 billion yuan in 12,747 technical development projects, it said.
Liaoning, a heavy industrial region, has many ageing state run industries that are badly in need of technical upgrades.
China has said one of its key targets over the next five years is the restructuring of ailing state industry.
